$comment: Thesis journal settings. A change is material when it moves by the absolute threshold for its unit, or by the relative threshold while also moving at least relativeFloorShare of the absolute threshold (so a yield that doubles from 1.5% to 3% counts, and noise near zero does not). Units without an absolute threshold use the relative one alone. ratio units are fractions (0.02 = 2 points); percent units are already in percent.
